interface.name: ivi_input_policy

description.summary: controller interface to the input system

interface.description: Handles input regions for surfaces in the IVI compositor.

request.name: add_input_rectangle

description.summary: add an input rectangle for a given surface ID

request.description: Add an input rectangle for the specified surface in the ivi compositor. Input events within this rectangle will be directed to the application providing the content for this surface.

request.name: clear_input_regions

description.summary: clear all input rectangles for a given surface ID

request.description: Clear all input rectangles for the specified surface in the ivi compositor. After this call, no input events will be directed to the application providing the content for this surface until new input rectangles are added.

request.name: reset_input_region

description.summary: reset input region for a given surface ID to full surface size

request.description: Reset the input region for the specified surface in the ivi compositor to cover the full size of the surface. After this call, input events will be directed to the application providing the content for this surface over its entire area.

request.name: commit_input_region

description.summary: commit input region changes for a given surface ID

request.description: Commit any pending input region changes for the specified surface in the ivi compositor. This makes any previously added or cleared input rectangles effective.
